description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space. 
 
 
 All roles require onsite presence a minimum of four days per week. Some roles may require five days onsite based on role responsibilities, business needs and manager discretion. Schedule flexibility may be available depending on the role and manager approval, including a 9/80 work schedule and compensatory time off (time off earned for hours worked beyond 40 per week) for eligible employees.


 The National Systems Group serves as the technical advisor to the Intelligence Community and its mission partners involved in the collection and distribution of national and tactical intelligence, including electronics programs, advanced technologies, ground and communications, imagery programs, and systems engineering and launch.

 The Enterprise Ground Systems Department provides analysis, recommendations, and studies to the SIGINT satellite program offices. We are currently looking for a Space Ground Systems Platform Engineer (Senior Project Engineer - Systems Software Engineering and Cloud Computing Architecture) to field and modernize ground systems to drive the government’s mission. The role requires working with the program office to tackle their hardest platform and processing challenges and build an Aerospace team to solve them. The program office works to define tasks and actively engage with the Aerospace Engineering Technology Group to bring the best talent to solve space ground system hard problems.

 What You'll Be Doing 
 Analyze and recommend solutions for the fielding and sustainment of ground system architecture, cloud and processing architecture, software design, acquisition strategies, operations, and maintenance.
 Work across the technology stack to analyze, engineer, design, and recommend fielding, test, operations, and sustainment of space ground system hardware and software to recommend platform implementation to include cloud, hybrid, and on-prem.
 Define and develop mission-critical interfaces (organizational, physical, functional, hardware/software, operational) for space ground control systems.
 Define and manage tasking to a team of support engineering staff and monitor delivery of professional engineering studies, recommendations, and analysis.
 Develop and analyze system requirements for engineering models, simulations, test beds, special test equipment, and end-to-end integration testing.
 Oversee system integration and test planning, execution, data evaluation, anomaly resolution, and risk assessment for operational and performance validation advising on automated testing, engineering models, simulations, test beds (including test beds that fold into the ground systems), special test equipment for all organizations involved with system testing, end-to-end system integration tests.
 
 What You Need to Be Successful 
 Minimum Requirements: 
 Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science or mathematics
 10 years or more experience with multiple aspects of space ground systems experience such as sustainment, enterprise integration, space vehicle to ground integration, ground systems development, and new technology insertion into existing systems
 Experience with SIGINT mission from multiple aspects of space systems integration, such as space-ground-user integration, payloads to spacecraft bus, spacecraft bus integration, ground software to hardware development and new technology insertion into existing space applications 
 Active Top Secret/SCI clearance, which is issued by the US government. US citizenship is required 
   
 How You Can Stand Out 
 It would be impressive if you had one or more of these: 
 Advanced degree in engineering, science or mathematics. 
 SIGINT Mission domain knowledge (e.g., system requirements, system integration and testing, spacecraft subsystems, manufacturing, test, and/or spacecraft operations
 Publication of applicable command media, training material, and/or technical papers 
 Demonstrated experience at a satellite mission site as a maintainer or operator 
 
 
 
 Leadership Competencies 
 Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who: 
 Operate Strategically 
 Lead Change    
 Engage with Impact    
 Foster Innovation    
 Deliver Results   
 
 Ways We Reward Our Employees 
 During your interview process, our team will provide details of our industry-leading benefits.
 Benefits vary and are applicable based on Job Type.  A few highlights include: 
 Comprehensive health care and wellness plans
 Paid holidays, sick time, and vacation
 Standard and alternate work schedules, including telework options
 401(k) Plan — Employees receive a total company-paid benefit of 8%, 10%, or 12% of eligible compensation based on years of service and matching contributions; employees are immediately eligible and vested in the plan upon hire
 Flexible spending accounts
 Variable pay program for exceptional contributions
 Relocation assistance
 Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career
 Education assistance programs
 A work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect
 
 We are all unique, from various backgrounds and all walks of life, yet one thing bonds all of us to each other—the belief that we can make a difference. This core belief empowers us to do our best work at The Aerospace Corporation.


 Equal Opportunity Commitment 
 The Aerospace Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, color, religion, genetic information, marital status, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, physical disability, medical condition, mental disability, or disability status and any other characteristic protected by state or federal law. If you’re an individual with a disability or a disabled veteran who needs assistance using our online job search and application tools or need reasonable accommodation to complete the job application process, please contact us by phone at 310.336.5432 or by email at  peoplemangmnt.mailbox@aero.org . You can also review  Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal .
